description_target.target_text: Pick the 3x3 subgrid with the most 1s from among isolated 3x3 shapes

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         ;; Find all 3x3 subgrids that are isolated (all 9 non-zero, and 0s around them)
         (candidates
          (for*/list ((r (range 0 (- h 2))) (c (range 0 (- w 2)))
                      #:when (and
                              ;; All 9 cells non-zero
                              (not (= (cell-at g r c) 0))
                              (not (= (cell-at g r (+ c 1)) 0))
                              (not (= (cell-at g r (+ c 2)) 0))
                              (not (= (cell-at g (+ r 1) c) 0))
                              (not (= (cell-at g (+ r 1) (+ c 1)) 0))
                              (not (= (cell-at g (+ r 1) (+ c 2)) 0))
                              (not (= (cell-at g (+ r 2) c) 0))
                              (not (= (cell-at g (+ r 2) (+ c 1)) 0))
                              (not (= (cell-at g (+ r 2) (+ c 2)) 0))
                              ;; Surroundings are 0 or out of bounds
                              (or (= r 0) (= (cell-at g (- r 1) c) 0))
                              (or (= r 0) (= (cell-at g (- r 1) (+ c 1)) 0))
                              (or (= r 0) (= (cell-at g (- r 1) (+ c 2)) 0))
                              (or (>= (+ r 3) h) (= (cell-at g (+ r 3) c) 0))
                              (or (>= (+ r 3) h) (= (cell-at g (+ r 3) (+ c 1)) 0))
                              (or (>= (+ r 3) h) (= (cell-at g (+ r 3) (+ c 2)) 0))
                              (or (= c 0) (= (cell-at g r (- c 1)) 0))
                              (or (= c 0) (= (cell-at g (+ r 1) (- c 1)) 0))
                              (or (= c 0) (= (cell-at g (+ r 2) (- c 1)) 0))
                              (or (>= (+ c 3) w) (= (cell-at g r (+ c 3)) 0))
                              (or (>= (+ c 3) w) (= (cell-at g (+ r 1) (+ c 3)) 0))
                              (or (>= (+ c 3) w) (= (cell-at g (+ r 2) (+ c 3)) 0))))
            (list r c)))
         (best
          (let loop ((cs candidates) (best-pos #f) (best-n -1))
            (cond
              ((null? cs) best-pos)
              (else
               (let* ((pos (car cs))
                      (r (first pos))
                      (c (second pos))
                      (ones
                       (+ (if (= (cell-at g r c) 1) 1 0)
                          (if (= (cell-at g r (+ c 1)) 1) 1 0)
                          (if (= (cell-at g r (+ c 2)) 1) 1 0)
                          (if (= (cell-at g (+ r 1) c) 1) 1 0)
                          (if (= (cell-at g (+ r 1) (+ c 1)) 1) 1 0)
                          (if (= (cell-at g (+ r 1) (+ c 2)) 1) 1 0)
                          (if (= (cell-at g (+ r 2) c) 1) 1 0)
                          (if (= (cell-at g (+ r 2) (+ c 1)) 1) 1 0)
                          (if (= (cell-at g (+ r 2) (+ c 2)) 1) 1 0))))
                 (if (> ones best-n)
                     (loop (cdr cs) pos ones)
                     (loop (cdr cs) best-pos best-n))))))))
    (let ((br (first best)) (bc (second best)))
      (grid-from-fn 3 3
        (lambda (r c) (cell-at g (+ br r) (+ bc c))))))))
